title.en: Lost Medicaid in Georgia 2026? Your 90-Day SEP Guide
title.es: Perdio Medicaid en Georgia 2026? Guia SEP de 90 Dias

description.en: Lost Georgia Medicaid or Pathways in 2026? You have 90 days to enroll in Georgia Access marketplace coverage. Steps, costs, and appeal rights explained.
description.es: Perdio Medicaid o Pathways en Georgia en 2026? Tiene 90 dias para inscribirse en cobertura del mercado Georgia Access. Pasos, costos y derechos de apelacion.

h1.en: Lost Your Medicaid in Georgia? Here Are Your Next Steps for 2026
h1.es: Perdio Su Medicaid en Georgia? Sus Proximos Pasos en 2026

subhero.en: You have 90 days from your Georgia Medicaid or Pathways termination date to enroll in a new plan through Georgia Access. You may also appeal the decision or re-qualify if your income changes.
subhero.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha de terminacion de su Medicaid o Pathways en Georgia para inscribirse en un nuevo plan a traves de Georgia Access. Tambien puede apelar la decision o volver a calificar si sus ingresos cambian.

heading.en: You have 90 days from your Georgia Medicaid termination date
heading.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha de terminacion de su Medicaid en Georgia

body.en: Your 90-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP) starts the day your Georgia Medicaid or Pathways coverage ends. For example, if your coverage ends June 1, 2026, your SEP window runs through August 30, 2026. Miss that window and you must wait until the next Open Enrollment Period (November 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027 for 2027 coverage) unless another qualifying life event occurs. File your appeal AND start your Georgia Access marketplace application at the same time to prevent a gap.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 90 dias comienza el dia en que termina su cobertura de Medicaid o Pathways en Georgia. Por ejemplo, si su cobertura termina el 1 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP va hasta el 30 de agosto de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, debera esperar hasta el siguiente Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta (1 de noviembre de 2026 al 15 de enero de 2027 para cobertura 2027). Presente su apelacion Y solicite cobertura en Georgia Access al mismo tiempo para evitar una brecha.

label.en: Georgia Pathways fair hearing appeal deadline (typically 30 days from notice)
label.es: Fecha limite de apelacion de audiencia justa de Pathways (generalmente 30 dias desde el aviso)

label.en: PeachCare for Kids (Georgia CHIP) and traditional Medicaid re-application
label.es: PeachCare para Ninos (CHIP de Georgia) y re-solicitud de Medicaid tradicional

quickAnswer.en: Losing Georgia Medicaid or Georgia Pathways to Coverage in 2026 triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period to enroll in a Georgia Access marketplace plan. Georgia has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA, so adults who lose Pathways coverage at 100% FPL ($15,960 for a single person in 2026) can qualify for ACA premium tax credits starting at 100% FPL through Georgia Access. Three actions to take immediately: (1) request a fair hearing through Georgia's Office of State Administrative Hearings if the termination looks incorrect, (2) re-apply at gateway.ga.gov if your income still qualifies for Georgia Pathways or traditional Medicaid, and (3) enroll in a Georgia Access marketplace plan within 90 days. PeachCare for Kids (Georgia CHIP) covers children year-round at up to 247% FPL regardless of the adult's coverage status.
quickAnswer.es: Perder el Medicaid de Georgia o Georgia Pathways to Coverage en 2026 activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para inscribirse en un plan del mercado Georgia Access. Georgia no ha expandido Medicaid bajo la ACA, por lo que los adultos que pierden cobertura de Pathways al 100% del FPL pueden calificar para creditos fiscales de prima del ACA desde el 100% del FPL a traves de Georgia Access. Tres acciones inmediatas: (1) solicitar una audiencia justa si la terminacion parece incorrecta, (2) volver a solicitar en gateway.ga.gov si sus ingresos aun califican, y (3) inscribirse en un plan de Georgia Access dentro de 90 dias. PeachCare para Ninos (CHIP de Georgia) cubre a los ninos todo el ano hasta el 247% del FPL.

introParagraphs.en: Georgia is one of 10 states that has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA, meaning the standard expansion threshold of 138% of the Federal Poverty Level does not apply here. Instead, Georgia runs the Pathways to Coverage program, a limited 1115 demonstration waiver offering Medicaid to adults ages 19 to 64 at incomes up to 100% FPL who document at least 80 qualifying activity hours per month. When Pathways or traditional Georgia Medicaid ends, the coverage gap between 100% FPL and the ACA subsidy floor at 100% FPL creates a narrow but real risk: some Georgians who lose Pathways for activity-reporting failures may not immediately qualify for subsidized marketplace coverage either, depending on their exact income. Knowing which pathway applies to you in 2026 is the first decision this page helps you make.
introParagraphs.es: Georgia es uno de los 10 estados que no ha expandido Medicaid bajo la ACA, lo que significa que el umbral de expansion estandar del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza no aplica aqui. En cambio, Georgia administra el programa Pathways to Coverage, una exencion de demostracion 1115 limitada que ofrece Medicaid a adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos de hasta el 100% del FPL que documentan al menos 80 horas de actividades calificadas al mes. Cuando termina Pathways o el Medicaid tradicional de Georgia, la brecha de cobertura entre el 100% del FPL y el piso de subsidios del ACA al 100% del FPL crea un riesgo real: algunos georgianos que pierden Pathways por fallas en el reporte de actividades pueden no calificar de inmediato para cobertura del mercado con subsidios, dependiendo de su ingreso exacto. Saber cual trayectoria aplica para usted en 2026 es la primera decision que esta pagina le ayuda a tomar.

introParagraphs.en: Georgia Access is Georgia's state-based marketplace for ACA plans, operating at georgiaaccess.gov rather than healthcare.gov. Georgians who lose Medicaid or Pathways coverage qualify for a 90-day Special Enrollment Period, which is longer than the standard 60-day SEP that applies to most other coverage losses. The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), signed July 4, 2025, added new work requirements for Medicaid expansion populations nationally and requires redeterminations every six months starting December 31, 2026. Georgia's Pathways waiver is extended through December 31, 2026, but the program will be restructured after that date to align with new federal rules. This guide covers the six steps to take after losing Georgia Medicaid, how to calculate whether you qualify for Georgia Access subsidies or re-qualify for Medicaid, and what happens to your children's coverage under PeachCare for Kids. Check the Medicaid income limits and ACA income limits for 2026 to understand your options before your 90-day clock expires.
introParagraphs.es: Georgia Access es el mercado estatal de Georgia para planes del ACA, operando en georgiaaccess.gov en lugar de healthcare.gov. Los georgianos que pierden cobertura de Medicaid o Pathways califican para un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias, que es mas largo que el SEP estandar de 60 dias para la mayoria de otras perdidas de cobertura. La Ley One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), firmada el 4 de julio de 2025, agrego nuevos requisitos de trabajo para las poblaciones de expansion de Medicaid a nivel nacional y requiere redeterminaciones cada seis meses a partir del 31 de diciembre de 2026. La exencion de Pathways de Georgia se extiende hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026, pero el programa se reestructurara despues de esa fecha. Esta guia cubre los seis pasos a seguir despues de perder el Medicaid de Georgia, como calcular si califica para subsidios de Georgia Access o vuelve a calificar para Medicaid, y que sucede con la cobertura de sus hijos bajo PeachCare para Ninos.

name.en: Read your Georgia Medicaid or Pathways termination notice immediately
name.es: Lea su aviso de terminacion de Medicaid o Pathways de Georgia de inmediato

text.en: Your Georgia Department of Community Health (DCH) or Division of Family and Children Services (DFCS) must send written notice before ending coverage. Check the notice for the exact termination date, the stated reason (income change, failure to document Pathways activity hours, paperwork error, or other), and the appeal deadline. Georgia generally allows 30 days to request a fair hearing before the Office of State Administrative Hearings (OSAH). Your 90-day Georgia Access SEP clock starts from the termination date on the notice, not from when you read it.
text.es: El Departamento de Salud Comunitaria (DCH) o la Division de Servicios Familiares e Infantiles (DFCS) de Georgia debe enviarle un aviso escrito antes de terminar su cobertura. Verifique la fecha exacta de terminacion, la razon indicada (cambio de ingresos, fallo en documentar horas de actividad de Pathways, error de papeleo, u otra), y la fecha limite de apelacion. Georgia generalmente permite 30 dias para solicitar una audiencia justa ante la Oficina de Audiencias Administrativas del Estado (OSAH). Su periodo SEP de 90 dias para Georgia Access comienza desde la fecha de terminacion en el aviso, no desde cuando lo lee.

name.en: File a fair hearing appeal if the termination looks wrong
name.es: Presente una apelacion de audiencia justa si la terminacion parece incorrecta

text.en: Call the Georgia DCH appeals line or visit pathways.georgia.gov/eligibility/appeal-eligibility-decision to submit a fair hearing request before the deadline stated in your notice. If your coverage was cut because Georgia did not receive activity-hour documentation that you did submit, that is a procedural error and you can request reinstatement with continuation of benefits during the appeal process. If you appeal before your coverage ends and request continuation of benefits within 10 days of the notice date, you may keep your Medicaid while the appeal is decided. Hearings are administered through OSAH and result in a written decision mailed to you.
text.es: Llame a la linea de apelaciones del DCH de Georgia o visite pathways.georgia.gov/eligibility/appeal-eligibility-decision para presentar una solicitud de audiencia justa antes de la fecha limite indicada en su aviso. Si su cobertura fue cortada porque Georgia no recibio documentacion de horas de actividad que usted si envio, eso es un error de procedimiento y puede solicitar reinstalacion con continuacion de beneficios durante el proceso de apelacion. Si apela antes de que termine su cobertura y solicita continuacion de beneficios dentro de los 10 dias de la fecha del aviso, puede mantener su Medicaid mientras se decide la apelacion.

name.en: Calculate your current household income against 2026 Georgia thresholds
name.es: Calcule su ingreso del hogar actual frente a los umbrales de Georgia 2026

text.en: Check your 2026 projected annual income against three key thresholds for Georgia: (1) at or below 100% FPL ($15,960 for a single person, $27,320 for a family of 3) means you may still qualify for Georgia Pathways if you meet activity requirements, or for traditional Medicaid if you are pregnant, disabled, elderly, or a child; (2) between 100% and 400% FPL means you qualify for ACA premium tax credits through Georgia Access; (3) above 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person in 2026) means full premium with no subsidy due to the 2026 ACA subsidy cliff. Use the federal poverty level calculator at /federal-poverty-level to confirm your exact percentage. Report your projected CURRENT annual income, not your prior-year tax income, when applying through Georgia Access or gateway.ga.gov.
text.es: Verifique su ingreso anual proyectado para 2026 frente a tres umbrales clave para Georgia: (1) en o por debajo del 100% FPL ($15,960 para una persona sola, $27,320 para una familia de 3) significa que puede calificar para Georgia Pathways si cumple los requisitos de actividad, o para Medicaid tradicional si esta embarazada, discapacitada, es anciana o es nino; (2) entre el 100% y el 400% FPL significa que califica para creditos fiscales de prima del ACA a traves de Georgia Access; (3) por encima del 400% FPL ($63,840 para una persona sola en 2026) significa prima completa sin subsidio debido al acantilado de subsidios ACA 2026.

name.en: Re-apply for Georgia Medicaid or Pathways at gateway.ga.gov if you still qualify
name.es: Vuelva a solicitar Medicaid o Pathways de Georgia en gateway.ga.gov si aun califica

text.en: Log in or create an account at gateway.ga.gov and select 'Medical Assistance' to apply for Georgia Medicaid or Pathways to Coverage. Traditional Medicaid in Georgia covers year-round: pregnant women up to 225% FPL, children up to 247% FPL under PeachCare for Kids (Georgia CHIP), and adults who are aged, blind, or disabled. Georgia Pathways covers non-disabled adults 19 to 64 up to 100% FPL who document 80 qualifying activity hours per month (employment, job training, education, caregiving a child under 6, or community service). Georgia has up to 45 days to process a Medicaid application. If you are denied again and your income has not changed, call the Georgia DFCS Customer Contact Center at 877-423-4746 to request clarification.
text.es: Inicie sesion o cree una cuenta en gateway.ga.gov y seleccione 'Asistencia Medica' para solicitar Medicaid o Pathways to Coverage de Georgia. El Medicaid tradicional de Georgia cubre todo el ano: mujeres embarazadas hasta el 225% FPL, ninos hasta el 247% FPL bajo PeachCare para Ninos (CHIP de Georgia), y adultos que son de edad avanzada, ciegos o discapacitados. Georgia Pathways cubre a adultos no discapacitados de 19 a 64 anos hasta el 100% FPL que documentan 80 horas de actividad calificada al mes. Georgia tiene hasta 45 dias para procesar una solicitud de Medicaid.

name.en: Start your Georgia Access SEP application at georgiaaccess.gov
name.es: Inicie su solicitud SEP de Georgia Access en georgiaaccess.gov

text.en: Visit georgiaaccess.gov and select 'I lost qualifying health coverage' as your qualifying life event. Choose Medicaid or CHIP as the type of coverage lost and enter your Georgia Pathways or Medicaid termination date. You have 90 days from that date to pick a plan. Compare Silver plans first if your income is between 100% and 250% FPL ($15,960 to $39,900 for a single person in 2026), because Silver plans on Georgia Access include cost-sharing reductions that can lower deductibles to as little as $150 and out-of-pocket maximums to under $3,000. Upload your Georgia DCH or DFCS termination letter within 30 days of selecting a plan. Your coverage typically starts the first day of the month after you enroll.
text.es: Visite georgiaaccess.gov y seleccione 'Perdi cobertura medica calificada' como su evento calificado de vida. Elija Medicaid o CHIP como el tipo de cobertura perdida e ingrese su fecha de terminacion de Pathways o Medicaid de Georgia. Tiene 90 dias desde esa fecha para elegir un plan. Compare primero los planes Silver si su ingreso esta entre el 100% y el 250% FPL ($15,960 a $39,900 para una persona sola en 2026), porque los planes Silver en Georgia Access incluyen reducciones en la participacion de costos que pueden bajar los deducibles a tan poco como $150.

name.en: Enroll your children in PeachCare for Kids (Georgia CHIP) separately
name.es: Inscriba a sus hijos en PeachCare para Ninos (CHIP de Georgia) por separado

text.en: PeachCare for Kids is Georgia's CHIP program and operates separately from adult Medicaid eligibility. Apply through gateway.ga.gov for children under age 19 whose household income is at or below 247% FPL (approximately $81,510 for a family of 4 in 2026). Children must be uninsured for two months before applying, except when coverage was involuntarily lost, which is exactly the situation after a Medicaid termination. Premiums under PeachCare for Kids range from $0 to $35 per month and include dental and vision coverage. PeachCare enrollment is year-round with no deadline, so children are not subject to the same 90-day SEP window as adults.
text.es: PeachCare para Ninos es el programa CHIP de Georgia y opera por separado de la elegibilidad de Medicaid para adultos. Solicite a traves de gateway.ga.gov para ninos menores de 19 anos cuyo ingreso del hogar este en o por debajo del 247% FPL (aproximadamente $81,510 para una familia de 4 en 2026). Los ninos deben haber estado sin seguro durante dos meses antes de solicitar, excepto cuando la cobertura se perdio involuntariamente, que es exactamente la situacion despues de una terminacion de Medicaid. Las primas bajo PeachCare para Ninos oscilan entre $0 y $35 al mes e incluyen cobertura dental y de vision. La inscripcion en PeachCare es todo el ano sin fecha limite.

footnote.en: 2026 Georgia Access marketplace costs depend on your exact income, household size, and the plans available in your county. Enhanced premium tax credits from ARPA and the IRA expired January 1, 2026, so the 2026 subsidy cliff at 400% FPL is in effect. Standard ACA premium tax credits still apply for incomes from 100% to 400% FPL. Cost-sharing reductions are available only on Silver plans for incomes between 100% and 250% FPL. COBRA continuation coverage is generally not applicable when leaving Medicaid (COBRA applies to employer-sponsored plans, not Medicaid programs), but if you had any period of employer coverage before Medicaid, that COBRA window runs separately.
footnote.es: Los costos del mercado Georgia Access 2026 dependen de su ingreso exacto, tamano del hogar y los planes disponibles en su condado. Los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados de ARPA y la IRA expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026, por lo que el acantilado de subsidios 2026 al 400% FPL esta vigente. Los creditos fiscales estandar del ACA aun aplican para ingresos del 100% al 400% FPL. La cobertura de continuacion COBRA generalmente no aplica al salir de Medicaid (COBRA aplica a planes de empleadores), pero si tuvo cobertura de empleador antes de Medicaid, esa ventana de COBRA corre por separado.

intro.en: The most costly mistakes Georgians make after losing Medicaid or Pathways coverage in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que cometen los georgianos despues de perder la cobertura de Medicaid o Pathways en 2026:

items.en: Waiting to act because you filed a Georgia Pathways appeal. Appeals through OSAH can take weeks. Apply for Georgia Access marketplace coverage at the same time as your appeal. If the appeal succeeds, you can cancel the marketplace plan without penalty.
items.es: Esperar para actuar porque presento una apelacion de Georgia Pathways. Las apelaciones a traves de OSAH pueden tardar semanas. Solicite cobertura del mercado Georgia Access al mismo tiempo que su apelacion. Si la apelacion tiene exito, puede cancelar el plan del mercado sin penalidad.

items.en: Missing the 90-day SEP window. Most people assume the standard 60-day window applies, but loss of Medicaid or CHIP triggers a longer 90-day window. Even so, the clock starts on the termination DATE on your notice, not the date you read the notice or the date coverage actually stopped.
items.es: Perder la ventana SEP de 90 dias. La mayoria de personas asume que aplica la ventana estandar de 60 dias, pero la perdida de Medicaid o CHIP activa una ventana mas larga de 90 dias. Aun asi, el reloj comienza en la fecha de terminacion en su aviso, no la fecha en que lo lee.

items.en: Enrolling on healthcare.gov instead of georgiaaccess.gov. Georgia runs its own state-based marketplace. Starting your application at healthcare.gov with a Georgia ZIP code should redirect you, but going directly to georgiaaccess.gov avoids confusion and is faster.
items.es: Inscribirse en healthcare.gov en lugar de georgiaaccess.gov. Georgia administra su propio mercado estatal. Comenzar su solicitud en healthcare.gov con un codigo postal de Georgia deberia redirigirlo, pero ir directamente a georgiaaccess.gov evita confusion y es mas rapido.

items.en: Assuming children lose coverage when adults do. PeachCare for Kids (Georgia CHIP) is evaluated separately. Children in your household may still qualify at incomes up to 247% FPL even if you as an adult no longer qualify for Medicaid. Apply through gateway.ga.gov immediately.
items.es: Asumir que los ninos pierden cobertura cuando los adultos la pierden. PeachCare para Ninos (CHIP de Georgia) se evalua por separado. Los ninos en su hogar aun pueden calificar con ingresos de hasta el 247% FPL aunque usted como adulto ya no califique para Medicaid.

items.en: Reporting last year's income instead of projected current income. Georgia Access and Medicaid both use Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) based on projected CURRENT-year income. If your income dropped since your last tax return (due to job change, Pathways activity-hour failure, or other reason), report your new projected income to maximize your subsidy.
items.es: Reportar el ingreso del ano pasado en lugar del ingreso proyectado actual. Georgia Access y Medicaid usan el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) basado en el ingreso proyectado del ANO ACTUAL. Si su ingreso bajo desde su ultima declaracion de impuestos, reporte su nuevo ingreso proyectado para maximizar su subsidio.

en: Missing the 90-day SEP window after Georgia Medicaid or Pathways termination: applications submitted after day 90 are rejected unless another qualifying life event has occurred
Applying on the federal healthcare.gov platform instead of Georgia's state-based marketplace at georgiaaccess.gov, causing processing delays or misrouting
Insufficient proof of the qualifying event: Georgia Access requires upload of the DCH or DFCS termination letter within 30 days of plan selection, and missing this document voids the SEP enrollment

heading.en: Georgia Access Marketplace vs Pathways Re-enrollment vs Appeal: Which Path Is Right for You?
heading.es: Mercado Georgia Access vs Reinscripcion en Pathways vs Apelacion: Cual Camino Es el Correcto para Usted?

body.en: Losing Georgia Medicaid or Pathways coverage in 2026 opens three parallel tracks, and the right move depends on why coverage ended and what your current income is. Georgia Pathways re-enrollment makes sense if your income remains at or below 100% FPL ($15,960 for a single person in 2026) and you can consistently document 80 qualifying activity hours per month through employment, training, caregiving for a child under 6, or community service. Pathways is free coverage with the same Medicaid benefits, but the activity-documentation requirement is the most common reason people cycle on and off the program. Georgia Access marketplace enrollment through georgiaaccess.gov is the right move for most adults whose income is between 100% and 400% FPL ($15,960 to $63,840 for a single person in 2026). At 100% to 150% FPL, Georgia Access Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions can have nearly $0 premiums and deductibles under $500. At 150% to 250% FPL, Silver CSR plans typically run $20 to $100 per month after premium tax credits. A Pathways appeal through the Office of State Administrative Hearings (OSAH) is worth pursuing simultaneously if your termination was caused by a paperwork error, a missed documentation deadline that was not your fault, or a disputed income calculation. Filing an appeal before your coverage ends lets you request continuation of benefits during the hearing process. Three tracks can run in parallel: appeal to reinstate Pathways, re-apply for Pathways if the appeal is long, AND enroll in Georgia Access as a backup. If the appeal succeeds, cancel the marketplace plan.
body.es: Perder la cobertura de Medicaid o Pathways de Georgia en 2026 abre tres caminos paralelos, y la accion correcta depende de por que termino la cobertura y cual es su ingreso actual. La reinscripcion en Georgia Pathways tiene sentido si su ingreso sigue en o por debajo del 100% FPL ($15,960 para una persona sola en 2026) y puede documentar consistentemente 80 horas de actividad calificada al mes a traves de empleo, capacitacion, cuidado de un nino menor de 6 anos, o servicio comunitario. La inscripcion en el mercado Georgia Access a traves de georgiaaccess.gov es la accion correcta para la mayoria de adultos cuyo ingreso esta entre el 100% y el 400% FPL ($15,960 a $63,840 para una persona sola en 2026). Entre el 100% y el 150% FPL, los planes Silver de Georgia Access con reducciones en la participacion de costos pueden tener primas casi de $0 y deducibles de menos de $500. Una apelacion de Pathways a traves de OSAH vale la pena si su terminacion fue causada por un error de papeleo, una fecha limite de documentacion perdida que no fue su culpa, o un calculo de ingresos disputado. Los tres caminos pueden ejecutarse en paralelo.

stateRules.rule: Georgia has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA. Adults ages 19-64 without disabilities, pregnancy, or aged/blind status can access Medicaid only through the Georgia Pathways to Coverage 1115 waiver, which requires 80 qualifying activity hours per month and covers incomes up to 100% FPL ($15,960 for a single person in 2026). The waiver is extended through December 31, 2026.

Georgia's state-based ACA marketplace is Georgia Access (georgiaaccess.gov), not healthcare.gov. Georgians must enroll through Georgia Access for ACA marketplace plans. Entering a Georgia ZIP code on healthcare.gov redirects to Georgia Access, but starting at georgiaaccess.gov is faster.

PeachCare for Kids is Georgia's CHIP brand, covering uninsured children under age 19 at household incomes up to 247% FPL (approximately $81,510 for a family of 4 in 2026). Enrollment is year-round through gateway.ga.gov. A two-month uninsured wait period is waived when coverage was lost involuntarily.

Georgia Medicaid fair hearings are administered by the Office of State Administrative Hearings (OSAH). The appeal deadline is typically 30 days from the termination notice date. Requesting continuation of benefits within 10 days of the notice may allow Medicaid to continue during the appeal.

heading.en: Georgia's Coverage Gap in 2026: What It Means If You Earn Below 100% FPL
heading.es: La Brecha de Cobertura de Georgia en 2026: Que Significa Si Gana Menos del 100% FPL

paragraphs.en: Georgia's decision not to expand Medicaid creates a situation unique among the 40 states and DC that did expand: adults earning below 100% FPL ($15,960 for a single person in 2026) who do not qualify for Georgia Pathways have no subsidized coverage option. ACA premium tax credits start at 100% FPL, not below it. Pathways requires 80 qualifying activity hours per month, meaning adults who cannot meet that requirement because of illness, irregular work, or caregiving responsibilities may fall into this coverage gap. Adults who lost Pathways specifically because they could not document activity hours are most at risk of landing in the gap rather than in the ACA subsidy zone. The KFF 2026 analysis estimates approximately 200,000 to 240,000 Georgians are affected by this gap.
paragraphs.es: La decision de Georgia de no expandir Medicaid crea una situacion unica entre los 40 estados y DC que si expandieron: los adultos que ganan menos del 100% FPL ($15,960 para una persona sola en 2026) que no califican para Georgia Pathways no tienen ninguna opcion de cobertura subsidiada. Los creditos fiscales de prima del ACA comienzan al 100% FPL, no por debajo. Pathways requiere 80 horas de actividad calificada al mes, lo que significa que los adultos que no pueden cumplir ese requisito debido a enfermedad, trabajo irregular o responsabilidades de cuidado pueden caer en esta brecha de cobertura. Los adultos que perdieron Pathways especificamente porque no pudieron documentar horas de actividad corren mayor riesgo. El analisis KFF 2026 estima que aproximadamente 200,000 a 240,000 georgianos se ven afectados por esta brecha.

paragraphs.en: Georgians in the coverage gap have limited options in 2026: (1) attempt to re-qualify for Georgia Pathways by resuming qualifying activities and documenting them through gateway.ga.gov; (2) access care through Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) that offer sliding-scale fees based on income; (3) apply for coverage under a different Medicaid category if your circumstances changed, such as pregnancy (covered up to 225% FPL), a new disability determination, or reaching age 65 for Medicare eligibility. The OBBBA, signed July 4, 2025, restructures Pathways after December 31, 2026, but the gap is not expected to close unless Georgia enacts full expansion separately.
paragraphs.es: Los georgianos en la brecha de cobertura tienen opciones limitadas en 2026: (1) intentar volver a calificar para Georgia Pathways reanudando actividades calificadas y documentandolas a traves de gateway.ga.gov; (2) acceder a atencion a traves de Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente (FQHC) que ofrecen tarifas escalonadas basadas en el ingreso; (3) solicitar cobertura bajo una categoria diferente de Medicaid si sus circunstancias cambiaron, como embarazo (cubierto hasta el 225% FPL), una nueva determinacion de discapacidad, o cumplir 65 anos para elegibilidad de Medicare.

heading.en: Documents Deep-Dive: Why Each Document Matters for Your Georgia SEP Application
heading.es: Analisis de Documentos: Por Que Cada Documento Importa para Su Solicitud SEP de Georgia

paragraphs.en: Georgia Access requires proof of the qualifying life event within 30 days of selecting a plan. The Georgia DCH or DFCS termination letter is the primary document that establishes both the qualifying life event (loss of Medicaid/Pathways coverage) and the termination date that starts your 90-day SEP clock. Without it, Georgia Access may place your SEP application on hold or reject it. Keep a copy of the letter the moment you receive it. If you lost the letter, call the Georgia DFCS Customer Contact Center at 877-423-4746 and request a duplicate termination notice.
paragraphs.es: Georgia Access requiere prueba del evento calificado de vida dentro de los 30 dias de seleccionar un plan. La carta de terminacion del DCH o DFCS de Georgia es el documento principal que establece tanto el evento calificado (perdida de cobertura Medicaid/Pathways) como la fecha de terminacion que inicia su periodo SEP de 90 dias. Sin ella, Georgia Access puede poner su solicitud SEP en espera o rechazarla. Guarde una copia de la carta en el momento en que la reciba. Si perdio la carta, llame al Centro de Contacto de Clientes de Georgia DFCS al 877-423-4746 y solicite un aviso de terminacion duplicado.

paragraphs.en: Proof of current income is used to calculate your Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for 2026 ACA premium tax credit eligibility through Georgia Access. Report your projected CURRENT-year income, not your prior-year tax return figure. If your income is irregular (gig work, seasonal employment, self-employment), use your best estimate for the remainder of 2026. Under-reporting income risks a reconciliation bill at tax time via Form 1095-A; over-reporting costs you subsidy dollars during the year. If your income changes significantly after you enroll, update your application on georgiaaccess.gov within 30 days to keep your subsidy accurate.
paragraphs.es: La prueba de ingreso actual se utiliza para calcular su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para la elegibilidad del credito fiscal de prima del ACA 2026 a traves de Georgia Access. Reporte su ingreso proyectado del ANO ACTUAL, no la cifra de su declaracion de impuestos del ano anterior. Si su ingreso es irregular (trabajo independiente, empleo estacional, trabajo por cuenta propia), use su mejor estimacion para el resto de 2026. Si sus ingresos cambian significativamente despues de inscribirse, actualice su solicitud en georgiaaccess.gov dentro de los 30 dias.

heading.en: Georgia Pathways Work Requirements in 2026 and What Changes After December 31
heading.es: Requisitos de Trabajo de Georgia Pathways en 2026 y Que Cambia Despues del 31 de Diciembre

paragraphs.en: Georgia Pathways to Coverage covers adults ages 19 to 64 at or below 100% FPL ($15,960 for a single person in 2026) who document at least 80 qualifying activity hours per month. Qualifying activities include: paid employment, job search or training, enrollment in an educational program, vocational rehabilitation services, caregiving for a child under age 6 (new for 2026), and approved community service. Documentation must be submitted through the Georgia Gateway portal at gateway.ga.gov at annual renewal; the program moved from monthly to annual documentation reporting in 2026. Caregiving for a child under 6 was added as a qualifying activity in 2026, allowing stay-at-home parents who previously fell out of Pathways for activity failures to re-qualify without meeting a traditional employment or training requirement.
paragraphs.es: Georgia Pathways to Coverage cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos en o por debajo del 100% FPL ($15,960 para una persona sola en 2026) que documentan al menos 80 horas de actividad calificada al mes. Las actividades calificadas incluyen: empleo remunerado, busqueda de empleo o capacitacion, inscripcion en un programa educativo, servicios de rehabilitacion vocacional, cuidado de un nino menor de 6 anos (nuevo para 2026), y servicio comunitario aprobado. La documentacion debe presentarse a traves del portal de Georgia Gateway en gateway.ga.gov en la renovacion anual.

paragraphs.en: After December 31, 2026, Georgia Pathways will be restructured under the OBBBA national framework. The federal law requires all states to implement community engagement requirements for Medicaid expansion populations by January 1, 2027, with standard work, training, education, or community service documentation. Georgia's waiver framework positions it ahead of most states because work requirements are already in effect. The bi-annual (every 6 months) redetermination schedule for Medicaid expansion adults also takes effect December 31, 2026 under OBBBA, though Georgia's non-expansion status means the exact application to Pathways enrollees is subject to CMS guidance. If you are enrolled in Pathways, expect a renewal or redetermination contact from Georgia DCH in late 2026 or early 2027 under the new rules.
paragraphs.es: Despues del 31 de diciembre de 2026, Georgia Pathways se reestructurara bajo el marco nacional de la OBBBA. La ley federal requiere que todos los estados implementen requisitos de participacion comunitaria para las poblaciones de expansion de Medicaid para el 1 de enero de 2027. La redeterminacion bianual (cada 6 meses) para adultos de expansion de Medicaid tambien entra en vigor el 31 de diciembre de 2026 bajo la OBBBA. Si esta inscrito en Pathways, espere un contacto de renovacion o redeterminacion del DCH de Georgia a finales de 2026 o principios de 2027.

en.question: How long do I have to enroll in Georgia Access after losing Georgia Medicaid or Pathways?
en.answer: You have 90 days from the date your Georgia Medicaid or Pathways coverage ended to enroll in a Georgia Access marketplace plan using the loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period (SEP). This is longer than the standard 60-day SEP that applies to most other qualifying life events. Your 90-day clock starts from the termination date on your DCH or DFCS notice, not the date you received the letter. Visit georgiaaccess.gov, select 'I lost qualifying health coverage,' choose Medicaid/CHIP as the coverage type, and enter your termination date. Upload your termination letter within 30 days of selecting a plan.

en.question: Can I appeal my Georgia Pathways termination in 2026?
en.answer: Yes. Every Medicaid recipient has the right to a fair hearing. Submit your appeal request to Georgia's Office of State Administrative Hearings (OSAH) before the deadline stated in your termination notice, which is typically 30 days from the notice date. Visit pathways.georgia.gov/eligibility/appeal-eligibility-decision to file online or call the Georgia DCH at 877-423-4746. If you appeal before your coverage ends and request continuation of benefits within 10 days of the notice date, Georgia may continue your Medicaid benefits while the hearing is decided. Common grounds for successful appeals include procedural errors where documentation was submitted but not processed, and disputed income calculations.

en.question: Why does Georgia Access not show up on healthcare.gov for Georgia residents?
en.answer: Georgia operates its own state-based ACA marketplace at georgiaaccess.gov rather than using the federal healthcare.gov platform. If you enter a Georgia ZIP code on healthcare.gov, the site should redirect you to Georgia Access, but starting directly at georgiaaccess.gov is faster and avoids confusion. Georgia Access launched for the 2024 plan year and has operated independently since. Seven carriers competed statewide for 2026 plans. If you are a Georgia resident, all ACA marketplace enrollment, plan comparisons, and subsidy applications must be completed on georgiaaccess.gov.

en.question: Do I qualify for Georgia Access subsidies after losing Medicaid?
en.answer: Yes, if your 2026 projected household income is between 100% and 400% FPL. For a single person in 2026, that is $15,960 to $63,840. For a family of 4, that is $33,000 to $132,000. Between 100% and 250% FPL, Silver plans on Georgia Access also qualify for cost-sharing reductions (CSRs) that dramatically lower your deductible and out-of-pocket maximum. The enhanced ACA premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act expired January 1, 2026, so the 2026 subsidy cliff at 400% FPL is in effect. If your income is above 400% FPL, you pay full premium with no ACA subsidy.

en.question: What if my income is below 100% FPL and I don't qualify for Georgia Pathways?
en.answer: Adults below 100% FPL who cannot meet the Georgia Pathways activity requirement, and who are not pregnant, elderly, disabled, or a child, fall into Georgia's coverage gap. ACA marketplace premium tax credits start at 100% FPL, so you do not qualify for Georgia Access subsidies. Options include: attempting to re-qualify for Pathways by resuming qualifying activities, accessing care at Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) that use sliding-scale fees, or checking whether your circumstances have changed enough to qualify for another Medicaid category such as pregnancy (up to 225% FPL) or a disability determination. Georgia has not enacted full Medicaid expansion, so the gap is not expected to close in 2026.

en.question: What happens to my children's coverage when I lose Georgia Medicaid?
en.answer: Children's coverage is evaluated separately. PeachCare for Kids is Georgia's CHIP program and covers uninsured children under age 19 at household incomes up to 247% FPL (roughly $81,510 for a family of 4 in 2026). The standard two-month uninsured waiting period is waived when coverage was involuntarily lost, which includes a Medicaid or Pathways termination. Premiums are $0 to $35 per month and include dental and vision. Apply through gateway.ga.gov year-round. Children do not face the same 90-day SEP window as adults and can be enrolled at any time if income-eligible.

en.question: What is Georgia Pathways to Coverage and how does it differ from regular Medicaid?
en.answer: Georgia Pathways to Coverage is a limited Medicaid program authorized under a federal 1115 demonstration waiver. It covers non-disabled adults ages 19 to 64 at or below 100% FPL who complete at least 80 qualifying activity hours per month through employment, job training, education, caregiving for a child under 6, or community service. Regular Medicaid in Georgia covers pregnant women (up to 225% FPL), children under PeachCare for Kids (up to 247% FPL), and adults who are aged, blind, or disabled. Georgia Pathways is the only pathway for healthy non-disabled working-age adults in Georgia to access Medicaid, and it covers roughly 5,000 to 7,000 enrollees, far fewer than full expansion would cover.

en.question: What changed with Georgia Medicaid in 2026 under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act?
en.answer: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), signed July 4, 2025, made two changes relevant to Georgia: (1) states with Medicaid expansion must conduct eligibility redeterminations every six months starting December 31, 2026, instead of annually. Georgia does not have full expansion, but CMS guidance will clarify how this applies to Pathways enrollees. (2) All states must implement community engagement requirements for Medicaid working-age adults by January 1, 2027. Georgia Pathways already has work requirements, but the Pathways waiver will be restructured to align with the new federal framework after December 31, 2026. If you are in Pathways, expect a renewal communication from Georgia DCH in late 2026 or early 2027.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tengo para inscribirme en Georgia Access despues de perder el Medicaid o Pathways de Georgia?
es.answer: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha en que termino su cobertura de Medicaid o Pathways de Georgia para inscribirse en un plan del mercado Georgia Access usando el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) por perdida de cobertura. Esto es mas largo que el SEP estandar de 60 dias que aplica a la mayoria de otros eventos calificados de vida. Su reloj de 90 dias comienza desde la fecha de terminacion en su aviso del DCH o DFCS, no la fecha en que recibio la carta. Visite georgiaaccess.gov, seleccione 'Perdi cobertura medica calificada', elija Medicaid/CHIP como tipo de cobertura, e ingrese su fecha de terminacion. Cargue su carta de terminacion dentro de los 30 dias de seleccionar un plan.

es.question: Puedo apelar la terminacion de mi Georgia Pathways en 2026?
es.answer: Si. Todo beneficiario de Medicaid tiene derecho a una audiencia justa. Presente su solicitud de apelacion ante la Oficina de Audiencias Administrativas del Estado (OSAH) de Georgia antes de la fecha limite indicada en su aviso de terminacion, que generalmente es 30 dias desde la fecha del aviso. Visite pathways.georgia.gov/eligibility/appeal-eligibility-decision para presentar en linea o llame al DCH de Georgia al 877-423-4746. Si apela antes de que termine su cobertura y solicita continuacion de beneficios dentro de los 10 dias de la fecha del aviso, Georgia puede continuar sus beneficios de Medicaid mientras se decide la audiencia.

es.question: Por que Georgia Access no aparece en healthcare.gov para los residentes de Georgia?
es.answer: Georgia opera su propio mercado ACA estatal en georgiaaccess.gov en lugar de usar la plataforma federal healthcare.gov. Si ingresa un codigo postal de Georgia en healthcare.gov, el sitio deberia redirigirlo a Georgia Access, pero comenzar directamente en georgiaaccess.gov es mas rapido y evita confusion. Georgia Access opero de forma independiente desde 2024. Si es residente de Georgia, toda la inscripcion en el mercado ACA, comparacion de planes y solicitudes de subsidios deben completarse en georgiaaccess.gov.

es.question: Califico para los subsidios de Georgia Access despues de perder Medicaid?
es.answer: Si, si su ingreso del hogar proyectado para 2026 esta entre el 100% y el 400% del FPL. Para una persona sola en 2026, eso es $15,960 a $63,840. Para una familia de 4, eso es $33,000 a $132,000. Entre el 100% y el 250% del FPL, los planes Silver en Georgia Access tambien califican para reducciones en la participacion de costos (CSR) que reducen drasticamente su deducible y maximo de bolsillo. Los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados del ACA expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026, por lo que el acantilado de subsidios 2026 al 400% del FPL esta vigente.

es.question: Que pasa si mi ingreso esta por debajo del 100% del FPL y no califico para Georgia Pathways?
es.answer: Los adultos por debajo del 100% del FPL que no pueden cumplir el requisito de actividad de Georgia Pathways, y que no estan embarazadas, son ancianos, discapacitados o ninos, caen en la brecha de cobertura de Georgia. Los creditos fiscales de prima del mercado ACA comienzan al 100% del FPL, por lo que no califica para subsidios de Georgia Access. Las opciones incluyen: intentar volver a calificar para Pathways reanudando actividades calificadas, acceder a atencion en Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente (FQHC) que usan tarifas escalonadas, o verificar si sus circunstancias han cambiado para calificar para otra categoria de Medicaid como embarazo (hasta el 225% del FPL).

es.question: Que sucede con la cobertura de mis hijos cuando pierdo el Medicaid de Georgia?
es.answer: La cobertura de los ninos se evalua por separado. PeachCare para Ninos es el programa CHIP de Georgia y cubre a ninos no asegurados menores de 19 anos con ingresos del hogar de hasta el 247% del FPL (aproximadamente $81,510 para una familia de 4 en 2026). El periodo de espera estandar de dos meses sin seguro se exime cuando la cobertura se perdio involuntariamente, lo que incluye una terminacion de Medicaid o Pathways. Las primas son de $0 a $35 al mes e incluyen cobertura dental y de vision. Solicite a traves de gateway.ga.gov todo el ano.

es.question: Que es Georgia Pathways to Coverage y como se diferencia del Medicaid regular?
es.answer: Georgia Pathways to Coverage es un programa de Medicaid limitado autorizado bajo una exencion de demostracion federal 1115. Cubre a adultos no discapacitados de 19 a 64 anos en o por debajo del 100% del FPL que completan al menos 80 horas de actividad calificada al mes a traves de empleo, capacitacion laboral, educacion, cuidado de un nino menor de 6 anos, o servicio comunitario. El Medicaid regular de Georgia cubre a mujeres embarazadas (hasta el 225% del FPL), ninos bajo PeachCare para Ninos (hasta el 247% del FPL), y adultos que son de edad avanzada, ciegos o discapacitados.

es.question: Que cambio con el Medicaid de Georgia en 2026 bajo la Ley One Big Beautiful Bill Act?
es.answer: La Ley One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), firmada el 4 de julio de 2025, hizo dos cambios relevantes para Georgia: (1) los estados con expansion de Medicaid deben realizar redeterminaciones de elegibilidad cada seis meses a partir del 31 de diciembre de 2026, en lugar de anualmente. (2) Todos los estados deben implementar requisitos de participacion comunitaria para adultos en edad laboral de Medicaid para el 1 de enero de 2027. La exencion de Pathways de Georgia se reestructurara para alinearse con el nuevo marco federal despues del 31 de diciembre de 2026. Si esta en Pathways, espere una comunicacion de renovacion del DCH de Georgia a finales de 2026 o principios de 2027.
